title: Audits are moving from point-in-time sampling to continuous evidence
angle: The audit model itself is changing. Teams that still treat compliance as an annual scramble are optimising for a process that is on its way out.
keyPoints: Auditors are increasingly relying on continuous evidence streams rather than point-in-time sampling.
Traditional GRC programmes were built around periodic audits and manual processes, which meant teams spent more time preparing for audits than actually managing risk.
The 2026 direction is control rationalisation: streamlining control catalogues rather than expanding them.
Integrated platforms are replacing siloed tools, pulling risk, compliance, audit and reporting into one place.

sources.title: GRC Trends for 2026: What Leaders Need to Know
